verdict.rationale: Customer.io offers a drag-and-drop visual editor plus a code editor in Design Studio, global styles for on-brand design, a reusable Assets library, and inbox previews for checking how emails render across clients. Message personalization with populated data is documented, and a hands-on user called building, editing and previewing emails straightforward and intuitive. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of reusable email templates or snippets, no description of the personalization token syntax, and no detail on cross-client rendering beyond the inbox-preview credit mention.
